topic: Properties and characteristics of light and sound
key_concepts: Light travels in a straight line.
Light can pass through aligned holes or openings.
Some objects reflect light while others do not.
Transparent objects allow light to pass through clearly.
Translucent objects blur light as it passes through.
Sounds can be loud or soft depending on the source.
Sound travels through air and through solid materials such as a string.
Refraction is the bending of light as it moves from one medium to another.
Sound intensity is measured in decibels.
Very high-intensity sound can damage the eardrum.
